name: LibreTranslate
tagline: Open-source, self-hostable translation API for privacy-friendly language apps
description: LibreTranslate is an open-source machine translation API you can self-host or use via public instances. It exposes simple HTTP endpoints for text translation, language detection, and supported language lists, making it suitable for privacy-conscious education and reference apps that need offline-capable or self-controlled translation without vendor lock-in.

auth.details: API key via api_key query param or JSON body field on hosted libretranslate.com; self-host typically needs no key. Public free tier may be limited or require key depending on instance.

use_cases: translate user-generated study notes between languages
detect language of a vocabulary list or article
build a privacy-friendly classroom translation tool
list supported languages for a language-learning UI
